title: Sheet lead.
officialText: Sheet lead for vent pipe flashings shall weigh not less than 3 pounds per square foot (15 kg/m2) for field-con-structed flashings and not less than 2.5 pounds per square foot (12 kg/m2) for prefabricated flashings.
